title: Blockchain & Crypto Analyst - India Roadmap
description: A comprehensive roadmap to becoming a Blockchain & Crypto Analyst in India, focusing on the unique skills required in Web3 (like on-chain analytics), the dynamic career path, and the opportunities within India's burgeoning crypto ecosystem.

nodes.label: What is a Blockchain Analyst?
nodes.description:
A Blockchain & Crypto Analyst is a financial detective in the Wild West of Web3. Unlike traditional finance, where data is hidden in quarterly reports, crypto data is public but hard to read.

These analysts bridge the gap between complex code and investment decisions. They work for Exchanges, Venture Capital funds, and Web3 protocols.

Core Responsibilities:

  • On-Chain Analysis: Investigating the 'Blockchain Ledger' to see where the 'Whales' (large investors) are moving their money.
  • Tokenomics Research: Analyzing the supply and demand of a token. Is the inflation rate too high? Are the incentives sustainable?
  • Due Diligence: Reading 'Whitepapers' and auditing the team's background to spot scams or 'Rug Pulls'.
  • Governance Participation: Voting on proposals in DAOs (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations) to shape the future of a protocol.

nodes.label: Education vs. Portfolio
nodes.description:
In Crypto, your degree matters less than your 'Proof of Work'.

  • Traditional Background: A degree in Computer Science (B.Tech) or Economics/Finance is a strong foundation. Engineers who understand 'Smart Contracts' are highly valued.
  • Self-Learning (The Real School): The industry moves too fast for colleges. You must learn from:
    • Twitter/X & Substack: Following top researchers.
    • Project Whitepapers: Reading the documentation of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Uniswap.
  • The 'Public Portfolio': This is your resume. Publishing Twitter Threads, Substack Articles, or Dune Dashboards analyzing a protocol is the best way to get hired.

nodes.label: The Web3 Analyst Stack
nodes.description:
You need a mix of Data Science and Economic Theory.

  • Hard Skills:
    • SQL: The #1 skill. You need SQL to query blockchain data from Dune Analytics or Flipside Crypto.
    • Tokenomics: Understanding Vesting Schedules, Staking Yields, and Burn Mechanisms.
    • Smart Contract Literacy: You don't need to code, but you must be able to read Solidity code on GitHub to check for basic risks.
  • Tools of the Trade:
    • On-Chain Analytics: Dune Analytics (for custom queries), Nansen (for tracking wallet labels), Glassnode (for macro data).
    • Market Data: Coingecko, Messari, TradingView.
    • Explorers: Proficiency in navigating Etherscan, Solscan, and BscScan.

nodes.label: Who Hires Crypto Analysts?
nodes.description:
India is a global hub for Web3 talent.

  • Indian Exchanges: CoinDCX, CoinSwitch Kuber, WazirX. They hire analysts to decide which new tokens to list on their platform.
  • Global Protocols (Remote): Many Indian analysts work remotely for global giants like Polygon (founded in India), Solana Foundation, or Uniswap.
  • Crypto VC Funds: Woodstock Fund, Hashed (India presence), CoinFund. These funds hire analysts to find the next unicorn before anyone else.
  • Research Firms: Messari, The Block, Delphi Digital. They often hire remote contributors from India.

nodes.label: Career Path
nodes.description:
The ladder is short but dynamic.

  1. Junior Analyst / Contributor: Writing daily market updates and creating basic dashboards.
  2. Research Analyst: Publishing deep-dive reports on specific sectors (e.g., 'DeFi Analyst' or 'NFT Analyst').
  3. Research Lead / Principal: Managing the firm's investment thesis and leading a team of analysts.
  4. Head of Tokenomics / Partner: Designing the economic structure for new projects or becoming a Partner in a VC fund.

nodes.label: Salary & Token Incentives
nodes.description:
Salaries are high, but often volatile. Compensation is usually a mix of Fiat (Cash) + Tokens.

  • Entry-Level (0-2 Years):
    ₹8 Lakhs to ₹15 Lakhs per annum (LPA).
    Talented SQL writers on Dune can earn more via bounties.
  • Mid-Level (Research Analyst):
    ₹20 Lakhs to ₹45 Lakhs LPA.
    Remote roles for US/EU firms often pay in USDC/USDT, significantly increasing purchasing power in India.
  • Senior-Level (Lead / Head):
    ₹50 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore+ LPA.
    Note: Token allocations (vested over 4 years) can turn into multi-crore windfalls during a Bull Market, but can be worth zero in a Bear Market.
